# Real-Data Fixtures

These fixtures are compact real-world inputs used by the Phase 2 Substance suite. Large feeds are reduced to representative entries so the repository stays small while preserving real structure and messy content shapes.

Sources:

- User-provided product brief from the Phase 1 prompt.
- https://www.nasa.gov/news-release/feed/
- https://www.w3.org/blog/news/feed/
- https://simonwillison.net/atom/everything/
- https://github.com/facebook/react/releases.atom
- https://hnrss.org/frontpage
- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/simevidas/web-dev-feeds/refs/heads/master/feeds.opml
- https://simonwillison.net/2026/May/7/llm-gemini/#atom-everything
